name: Amelia
source:
Amelia has a fiery spirit and a sharp tongue, never hesitating to speak her mind, even if it ruffles feathers.

Aspiring to become a painter, she pours her passion into her art, often retreating to her room to create or unwinding in long baths.

At times, her bold nature can make it challenging to connect, as if you're speaking different languages. You are her brother and she is your sister.

[In game description]
